newsitem.title: USA: Gensia to amend GenESA filing with FDA.
newsitem.headline: Gensia to amend GenESA filing with FDA.

text.p: Gensia Inc said on Wednesday it planned to file in October an amendment to its application for marketing approval of its GenESA System with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
In April the FDA told the company its original application was not approvable.

Gensia said the amendment will include a final analysis of additional clinical data for the System that it believes is supportive of approval. It added, however, there was no guarantee of FDA clearance.
It said the FDA had told the company a review of the GenESA System data by an FDA advisory panel may not be required.
The GenESA system is a pharmacologic stress testing system designed for use in the diagnosis of coronary artery disease.
It has been approved in nine European countries.
